content.short: Holyheld offers a single debit card for all Web3 needs.
content.description: Holyheld is a Web3 debit card that comes with a personal IBAN, letting you access on-chain funds for everyday spending. It works with your non-custodial wallet and supports six networks natively, so you can use digital assets across networks without bridging steps or waiting. Whether you’re getting paid in crypto, contributing to a DAO, trading on DEXs, or collecting and minting NFTs, Holyheld makes your crypto usable for everyday purchases and practical transactions.
